item.title: 5-year-old victim identified in Oregon school shooting
item.description: Memorials with flowers,​ balloons and stuffed animals popped up around the school after the shooting.

item.title: Hero bystander who took down Oregon school shooter comes forward
item.description: The bystander who pursued and killed the Silver Rail Elementary School shooter is thanking first responders and the community for their support.

item.title: Trump opens door to Katie Zacharia leaving as press secretary
item.description: President Trump signaled on Friday that Katie Zacharia, his new White House press secretary, might not be in the role for long.

item.title: Timeline of Oregon elementary school shooting as new details revealed about victims, shooter
item.description: Three children and a teacher were killed when a 16-year-old opened fire at a Bend, Oregon, elementary school Thursday. CBS News' Elizabeth Campbell has the latest details and Katherine Schweit, a former FBI agent and mass shooting expert, joins with analysis on the investigation.

item.title: With Tesla Roadster debut, Elon Musk shows "flying cars are real"
item.description: Elon Musk unveiled Tesla's new Roadster, which uses high-pressure air thrusters to leave the road entirely during a livestreamed event at his SpaceX facility in Texas.

item.title: Oregon school shooter ID'd, used shotgun bought by mother, source say
item.description: Investigators are combing through the 16-year-old's computer, phone, social media and search history for clues after the shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, sources say.

item.title: 3 children, 1 teacher killed in Oregon school shooting, police say
item.description: Three children and a teacher were killed, and two others critically wounded, in a shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon. The suspect was shot and killed by a bystander.

item.title: Iran's president denies nuclear ambitions, says he's ready for talks
item.description: Iran said Friday the Strait of Hormuz will reopen if the U.S. leaves the Middle East, adding, "If it does not leave, we will expel it."

item.title: U.S. embargo, sanctions on Cuba impacting power, access to medicine
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says the campaign is engineered to make the government feel like there are no escape valves, which is how people in Cuba describe feeling.

item.title: This week on "Sunday Morning" (Oct. 18)
item.description: A look at the features for this week's broadcast of the Emmy-winning program, hosted by Jane Pauley.

item.title: Chad Michael Murray on new Buffalo Bills docuseries, "One Tree Hill" reboot chances
item.description: Chad Michael Murray, a huge Buffalo Bills fan, is the executive producer of the new Tubi docuseries "Just One Before I Die." He joins CBS News with more.

item.title: H.R. McMaster on Trump's "mother of all bombs" plan, Putin "talking" in his ear
item.description: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, who served as an adviser to President Trump, breaks down what's known about the "mother of all bombs," which sources say was discussed in relation to the Iran war. McMaster also reacts to Mr. Trump's latest comments on the Russia-Ukraine war.

item.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy has stunning reaction when asked if he is Trump's scapegoat
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy had a peculiar reaction when asked about President Trump while meeting with European Council leaders. CBS News' Aidan Stretch reports.

item.title: Amber Guyger released after 7 years in prison for neighbor's murder
item.description: Former Dallas police officer Amber Guyger has been released on parole after serving seven years of a 10-year sentence for the 2018 murder of Botham Jean.

item.title: Book excerpt: "Your Turn: How to Create a Midlife You Love"
item.description: NPR health and science correspondent and "Sunday Morning" contributor Allison Aubrey writes about the steps Gen Xers may take to foster a sense of purpose as they enter this next stage of life.

item.title: JD Vance says he would comply with subpoenas and that he follows the law
item.description: Vice President JD Vance took questions about concerns of corruption in the Trump administration while speaking to CBS Evening News anchor Tony Dokoupil for a town hall.

item.title: Dad describes waiting for news after fatal Oregon school shooting; expert explains motive probe
item.description: More details are emerging about the fatal shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon. CBS News' Elizabeth Campbell reports, and Kevin Robinson, a law enforcement expert and Phoenix city councilmember, joins with more insight.

item.title: Sacha Baron Cohen shares the mission behind his comedy
item.description: Sacha Baron Cohen says the primary objective of his comedy is to "get people to laugh really hard. And smuggled in there is a bit of satire." Watch more of Ariel Levy's interview with Cohen this Sunday on 60 Minutes.

item.title: How much of Sacha Baron Cohen is in Ali G?
item.description: Does Sacha Baron Cohen bring any element of himself into characters like Ali G, Borat and Bruno? "If I knew who I was, then I could answer that. But I don't know. I mean, Ali G definitely, because in a way, at the age of 11, I was an Ali G of sorts," Baron Cohen says. This Sunday, the actor sits down with 60 Minutes' Ariel Levy.

item.title: Photos show pope celebrating Mass at hospital after cancer surgery
item.description: The Vatican also released photos of some get-well notes that had been sent to Pope Leo from patients in the hospital's pediatric oncology ward.

item.title: Noah Centineo says he loved "Minecraft" so much, he joined the cast of "Street Fighter"
item.description: Former teen heartthrob Noah Centineo stars in video game adaptation "Street Fighter." Centineo spoke with Nate Burleson about why he joined the project.

item.title: American journalist injured in West Bank clashes
item.description: Among the injured was Heidi Levine, a veteran American photojournalist working with the Washington Post.

item.title: Answers on Amelia Earhart's plane disappearance could be days away. Here's what we know.
item.description: A team of researchers has honed in on a specific piece of potential evidence that could crack open the mystery of Amelia Earhart's disappearance. CBS News' Lana Zak breaks down the latest.

item.title: Oregon mom says she ran to son's school when co-worker heard gunshots
item.description: Kayla and Tyler Major's son was uninjured in the mass shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon. Three children and a teacher were killed, police said.

item.title: New guidelines support hormone therapy for menopause symptoms
item.description: A leading OB-GYN organization now recommends hormone replacement therapy for many women experiencing common menopause symptoms including hot flashes.

item.title: Eric Deters files defamation lawsuit against Kimberly Guilfoyle
item.description: Eric Deters, a GOP donor who said Kimberly Guilfoyle asked him to wire her $100,000, has sued her and her lawyers.

item.title: Alleged Chinese agent has ties to scam group, records show
item.description: A California realtor charged with working as a Chinese agent and her partner have links to individuals involved in sprawling criminal enterprises, according to federal court filings.

item.title: Kristi Noem no longer serving as envoy to Shield of the Americas
item.description: Former DHS Secretary Kristi Noem is no longer serving as the Trump administration's envoy to the Shield of the Americas initiative, a State Department official said.

item.title: White House prepares plans to use "mother of all bombs" on Iran
item.description: The White House and Pentagon have prepared plans to use a Massive Ordnance Air Blast bomb to hit military sites in Iran if ordered by President Trump, sources familiar with the matter told CBS News.

item.title: How some AI models are more vulnerable to manipulation
item.description: China has embraced open-weight models, a development that researchers say is closing the AI capability gap between the country and the U.S.
